# listmonk_user (Resource)

Manages a listmonk user: a person who logs in to the admin UI (`type = "user"`) or an API user (`type = "api"`). For API users the generated token is exported as `api_token`; listmonk shows it only once, at creation, so it is only available for users created by Terraform (not for imported ones).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "listmonk_user_role" "campaign_manager" {
  name        = "Campaign manager"
  permissions = ["campaigns:get_all", "campaigns:manage_all", "templates:get"]
}

# A person who logs in through OIDC (no password login).
resource "listmonk_user" "alex" {
  username     = "alex"
  name         = "Alex Example"
  email        = "alex@example.com"
  user_role_id = listmonk_user_role.campaign_manager.id
}

# An API user for an integration. The token is only known to Terraform for
# users it created; store it in a secret manager.
resource "listmonk_user" "crm_sync" {
  username     = "crm-sync"
  type         = "api"
  user_role_id = listmonk_user_role.campaign_manager.id
}

output "crm_sync_token" {
  value     = listmonk_user.crm_sync.api_token
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `user_role_id` (Number) ID of the user role (`listmonk_user_role`, or 1 for Super Admin).
- `username` (String) Login name: at least 3 characters out of letters, digits and `_ - . @`.

### Optional

- `email` (String) E-mail address. Required for `type = "user"`; not used for API users.
- `list_role_id` (Number) ID of an optional list role (`listmonk_list_role`).
- `name` (String) Display name. Defaults to the username.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password (at least 8 characters) when `password_login` is enabled. listmonk never returns it, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `password_login` (Boolean) Allow logging in with a password (instead of only OIDC). Defaults to `false`. Not available for API users.
- `status` (String) `enabled` or `disabled`. Defaults to `enabled`.
- `type` (String) `user` or `api`. Defaults to `user`. Changing it replaces the user.

### Read-Only

- `api_token` (String, Sensitive) API token of an API user, generated by listmonk at creation. Null for `type = "user"` and for imported API users.
- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the user.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Users are imported by their numeric ID. The API token of an imported
# API user is not available.
terraform import listmonk_user.alex 7
```
